     7  module
     8  
     9  public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Schwarz
    10  
    11  /-!
    12  # Borel-Carathéodory theorem
    13  
    14  This file proves the Borel-Carathéodory theorem: for any function `f` analytic on the
    15  open ball `|z| < R` such that `Re(f z) < M` for all `|z| < R`, we have
    16  `‖f z‖ ≤ 2 * M * ‖z‖ / (R - ‖z‖) + ‖f 0‖ * (R + ‖z‖) / (R - ‖z‖)`
    17  
    18  ## Main results
    19  
    20  * `Complex.borelCaratheodory_zero`: The theorem under the assumption `f 0 = 0`
    21  * `Complex.borelCaratheodory`: The general version of the theorem
    22  
    23  ## Implementation Notes
    24  
    25  The proof applies the Schwarz lemma to the transformed function `w z := f z / (2 * M - f z)`,
    26  which maps the ball `|z| < R` into the unit disk provided that `(f z).re ≤ M` for all `|z| < R`.
    27  After obtaining bounds on `w`, we invert the transformation to recover bounds on `f`.
    28  
    29  ## Tags
    30  
    31  complex analysis, Borel, Carathéodory, analytic function, growth bound
    32  -/
    33  
    34  open Metric
    35  
    36  namespace Complex
    37  
    38  variable {f : ℂ → ℂ} {s : Set ℂ} {M R : ℝ} {z w : ℂ}
    39  
    40  section SchwarzTransform
    41  
    42  /-- If `w = z / (2M - z)`, then `z = 2M * w / (1 + w)`. This is the inverse of the
    43  Schwarz transform used in the proof of the Borel-Carathéodory theorem. -/
    44  lemma eq_mul_div_one_add_of_eq_div_sub (_ : M ≠ 0) (_ : 2 * M - z ≠ 0)
    45      (h : w = z / (2 * M - z)) : z = 2 * M * w / (1 + w) := by
    46    rw [h]; field_simp; ring_nf; rw [mul_inv_cancel_right₀]; norm_cast
    47  
    48  /-- Norm inequality for the inverse Schwarz transform: if `‖w‖ < 1`, then
    49  `‖2M * w / (1 + w)‖ ≤ 2M * ‖w‖ / (1 - ‖w‖)`. -/
    50  lemma norm_two_mul_div_one_add_le (hM : 0 < M) (hw : ‖w‖ < 1) :
    51      ‖2 * ↑M * w / (1 + w)‖ ≤ 2 * M * ‖w‖ / (1 - ‖w‖) := by
    52    simp only [norm_div, norm_mul, norm_ofNat, norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hM]
    53    gcongr
    54    rw [← norm_one (α := ℂ)]; exact norm_sub_le_norm_add 1 w
    55  
    56  /-- If `z.re ≤ M`, then `‖z‖ ≤ ‖2M - z‖`. This shows that the Schwarz transform
    57  `z ↦ z / (2M - z)` has numerator smaller than denominator when the real part is bounded by M -/
    58  lemma norm_le_norm_two_mul_sub (_ : 0 < M) (_ : z.re ≤ M) : ‖z‖ ≤ ‖2 * M - z‖ := by
    59    rw [← sq_le_sq₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    60    suffices z.re * z.re ≤ (2 * M - z.re) * (2 * M - z.re) by simpa [Complex.sq_norm, normSq_apply]
    61    nlinarith
    62  
    63  /-- Application of the Schwarz lemma to the transformed function. If `f` is differentiable on
    64  the ball, maps into `{z | z.re ≤ M}`, and satisfies `f 0 = 0`, then the Schwarz transform
    65  satisfies the bound from the Schwarz lemma. -/
    66  lemma schwarz_applied (hM : 0 < M) (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (ball 0 R))
    67      (hf₁ : Set.MapsTo f (ball 0 R) {z | z.re ≤ M}) (hz : z ∈ ball 0 R) (hf₂ : f 0 = 0) :
    68      ‖f z / (2 * M - f z)‖ ≤ (1 / R) * ‖z‖ := by
    69    rw [← dist_zero_right, ← dist_zero_right]
    70    nth_rw 1 [← zero_div (2 * M - f 0), ← hf₂]
    71    apply dist_le_div_mul_dist_of_mapsTo_ball (R₂ := 1) ?_ (fun x hx ↦ ?_) hz
    72    · apply hf.div (hf.const_sub _) fun x hx h ↦ ?_
    73      have := sub_eq_zero.mp h ▸ hf₁ hx
    74      aesop
    75    · simpa [hf₂] using
    76        div_le_one_of_le₀ (norm_le_norm_two_mul_sub hM (hf₁ hx)) (by positivity)
    77  
    78  end SchwarzTransform
    79  
    80  section BorelCaratheodory
    81
